headline: Pokemon Go: born from a joke
title: Pokemon Go Grew From a Google April Fools Joke | Classic Games
video_script: Pokemon Go has a funny origin. On April first, twenty fourteen, Google Maps ran a prank called the Pokemon Challenge, where you could catch Pokemon on the map. Engineer Tatsuo Nomura led it, and later directed Pokemon Go at Niantic. The game launched on July sixth, twenty sixteen, and Guinness said it was the fastest mobile game to earn one hundred million dollars, in just twenty days. Did you catch them all? Comment below!
description: Pokemon Go grew out of the Google Maps Pokemon Challenge April Fools project of 2014, led by Tatsuo Nomura. It launched July 6, 2016, and Guinness World Records recognized it as the fastest mobile game to gross 100 million dollars, in 20 days.
